scanNote:
2-MODUL O'Z-O'ZINI BAHOLASH, BIRINChI BET (60-bet).

Yuqorida yashil-oq fonli sarlavha: 'Module' (och yashil ramkada) va 'Self-Assessment 2 (Units 5 - 8)'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Vocabulary'.
1) 'Underline the correct word.' 12 gap, qalin juftliklar: 1 deep/anxious 2 costumes/uniforms 3 junk/low-fat 4 benefits/retires 5 ill/sick 6 strict/serious 7 improve/provide 8 treated/trained 9 lifting/rocking 10 deserted/crowded 11 experiences/standards 12 gathered/covered. (12 marks)
2) 'Fill in the correct word from the list.' Qiya: poached, pass, full-time, sore, vegetarian, constantly, guided, local, decade, shook. O'nta gap. (10 marks)
3) 'Fill in the missing preposition from the list.' Qiya: about, on, for, in, as, at. 1 They suddenly noticed a light ...... the distance. 2 They work ...... Greenpeace. 3 My uncle works ...... a teacher at my school. (O'NG USTUNDA davom:) 4 Everyone laughed except ...... Jonathan. 5 Don't worry ...... it. Things will get better. 6 He complained to the manager ...... the bad service. 7 ...... the moment I'm studying to become a doctor. 8 Teresa is ...... a diet. (8 marks)

O'NG USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Grammar'.
4) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect simple.' SURAT: kamin oldida bayramona dasturxon - shampan, salatlar, tovuq, gullar. Besh gap. (5 marks)
5) 'Underline the correct word(s).' O'nta gap: 1 a few/much 2 a little/any 3 some/any 4 much/many 5 a little/much 6 for/since 7 much/many 8 yet/already 9 any/much 10 many/much.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '60'.

exercises.explanationUz:
5-8 UNITLAR LUG'ATI - 12 BAND.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 DEEP in thought (58-bet)
  2 UNIFORMS (44-bet)
  3 JUNK food (40-bet)
  4 RETIRES (52-bet)
  5 SICK people (35-bet)
  6 STRICT diet (41-bet)
  7 IMPROVE conditions (48-bet)
  8 TREATED patients (48-bet)
  9 ROCKING from side to side
    (55-bet)
  10 DESERTED (58-bet)
  11 STANDARDS of health care
    (48-bet)
  12 GATHERED overhead (58-bet)


⚠ 2-BAND - 'COSTUME':

  costume = liboslar (teatr,
  karnaval); uniform = forma
  (ish).


⚠ 5-BAND - 'SICK PEOPLE':

  Britaniyada 'ill' OTDAN OLDIN
  turmaydi (35-bet).

5 Doctors help ___ people.

7 The new manager worked hard to ___ working conditions in the hotel.
8 Dianne has ___ thousands of patients in Angola.
9 Suddenly the boat began ___ from side to side.
10 There was no one on the beach. It was ___.
11 This hospital has high ___ of health care.
12 Jim noticed dark clouds which had ___ overhead.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct word from the list. (10 marks)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 LOCAL gym (35-bet)
  2 POACHED eggs (41-bet)
  3 a DECADE (48-bet)
  4 FULL-TIME job (35-bet)
  5 PASS the test (35-bet)
  6 SORE throat (48-bet)
  7 CONSTANTLY (41-bet)
  8 GUIDED tour (55-bet)

⚠ 3-BAND:

  'In a DECADE, computers will be

  = rivojlangan, ilg'or.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing preposition from the list: about, on, for, in, as, at. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan predlogni qo'ying: about, on, for, in, as, at. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:

  1 IN the distance (55-bet)
  2 work FOR Greenpeace (49-bet)
  3 works AS a teacher (35-bet)
  4 except FOR Jonathan (55-bet)
  5 worry ABOUT it (41-bet)

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the past simple or the past perfect simple. (5 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple yoki past perfect simple ga qo'ying. (5 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
OLDINGI VOQEA → PAST PERFECT.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 The chef HAD PREPARED the food by
    the time the guests ARRIVED.
  2 When I CAME home, I saw that she
    HAD ALREADY DONE the shopping.
  3 The war HAD ENDED when Jim BEGAN
    his job in Chile.
  4 She HAD JUST ENTERED her house
    when the earthquake STARTED.
  5 He HAD JUST PUT the phone down
    when it RANG again.


⚠ 'AN EARTHQUAKE':

  = zilzila.
  ⚠ 'earth' + 'quake' (tebranish).


⚠ 'TO PUT THE PHONE DOWN':

  = go'shakni qo'ymoq.

items.textEn: 1 The chef ___ (prepare) the food by the time the guests ___ (arrive).
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'by the time' + past simple; oldingi voqea
past perfect.

items.textEn: 2 When I ___ (come) home, I saw that she ___ (already/do) the shopping.
3 The war ___ (end) when Jim ___ (begin) his job in Chile.
4 She ___ (just/enter) her house when the earthquake ___ (start).
5 He ___ (just/put) the phone down when it ___ (ring) again.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'had just put' - oldingi; 'rang' - keyingi.
⚠ ring - RANG - rung.

exercises.explanationUz:
MIQDOR SO'ZLARI VA VAQT SO'ZLARI.


JAVOBLAR:

  1 A FEW sweets (sanaladigan, tasdiq)
  2 ANY books (savol)
  3 SOME people (tasdiq)
  4 How MANY patients (sanaladigan)
  5 A LITTLE milk (sanalmaydigan)
  6 SINCE 1998 (boshlanish nuqtasi)
  7 How MUCH ham (sanalmaydigan)
  8 has ALREADY done (tasdiq)
  9 aren't ANY eggs (inkor)
  10 aren't MANY crisps (sanaladigan,
     inkor)


⚠ 42-BETDAGI QOIDA:

  SANALADIGAN: many, a few, some, any
  SANALMAYDIGAN: much, a little,
     some, any


⚠ 'A TIN':

  = quti (metall).
  ⚠ 'a tin of sweets' = bir quti
  shirinlik.

items.textEn: 1 There are ___ sweets in the tin.
2 Have we got ___ books about computers?
3 There are ___ people waiting for the doctor.
4 How ___ patients has the doctor treated this morning?
5 There's only ___ milk left in the fridge.
6 I have been here ___ 1998.
7 How ___ ham do you need?
8 He has ___ done his homework.
9 There aren't ___ eggs left.

patterns.formula: [Ega] had + 3-ShAKL by the time [ega] + PAST SIMPLE.
patterns.exampleEn: The chef had prepared the food by the time the guests arrived.
patterns.exampleUz: Mehmonlar kelgan paytga kelib oshpaz ovqatni tayyorlab bo'lgan edi.

patterns.exampleEn: There's only a little milk left in the fridge.
